:stop_sign: **Syntax Error**: Invalid exception handling syntax will cause a runtime crash. Use parentheses to catch multiple exception types.
```suggestion
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
```

Reviewed against the supported runtime: pyproject.toml requires Python >=3.14 and Ruff targets py314. This multiple-exception syntax is valid in Python3.14. The module compiled and executed in the full locked harness (5188 passing tests); no syntax change is needed.
